# MyTranscript.pro — Comprehensive Platform Documentation & Knowledge Base

> MyTranscript (https://www.mytranscript.pro) is a high-performance, privacy-friendly AI web platform designed for automated YouTube transcription, plain-text extraction, subtitle downloads, and intelligent video summarization.

---

## 1. Core Tools & Intent Routes

### YouTube Transcript Generator
- **URL**: https://www.mytranscript.pro/youtube-transcript
- **Description**: Extract and view accurate YouTube transcripts instantly online with synchronized timestamps. Jump to key moments in the video with exact time offsets, or copy full dialogue to clipboard.

### Free YouTube Transcript Generator
- **URL**: https://www.mytranscript.pro/youtube-transcript-generator
- **Description**: Free online tool to generate full transcripts from YouTube videos with timestamps, speaker text, and clean export.

### AI YouTube Video Summarizer
- **URL**: https://www.mytranscript.pro/youtube-summary
- **Description**: Generate instant AI video summaries, bulleted key takeaways, and chapter breakdowns using high-context LLMs.

### YouTube Summarizer
- **URL**: https://www.mytranscript.pro/youtube-summarizer
- **Description**: Summarize any YouTube video instantly with AI. Read bullet points, executive summaries, and action items without watching hours of video.

### YouTube to Text Converter
- **URL**: https://www.mytranscript.pro/youtube-to-text
- **Description**: Easily convert YouTube video dialogue into clean plain text for notes, articles, research, or documentation.

### Podcast Transcript Generator
- **URL**: https://www.mytranscript.pro/podcast-transcript
- **Description**: Generate clean transcripts for video podcasts on YouTube. Extract full audio transcripts effortlessly for studying or show notes.

### Download YouTube Transcripts
- **URL**: https://www.mytranscript.pro/download-youtube-transcript
- **Description**: Export and download full transcripts from YouTube videos in TXT, SRT, or PDF formats with accurate timestamps.

### YouTube to SRT Converter
- **URL**: https://www.mytranscript.pro/youtube-to-srt
- **Description**: Convert YouTube video dialogue and captions into standard SubRip (.srt) subtitle files with millisecond timecodes for Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, and Final Cut.

### YouTube to Text Without Timestamps
- **URL**: https://www.mytranscript.pro/youtube-to-text-no-timestamps
- **Description**: Extract continuous plain text dialogue without timecodes or line-breaks, formatted for ChatGPT, Claude, and note-taking.

### YouTube Chapters Generator
- **URL**: https://www.mytranscript.pro/chapters
- **Description**: Automatically divide any YouTube video into clear, timestamped chapters for video descriptions and viewer retention.

### YouTube Infographic Generator
- **URL**: https://www.mytranscript.pro/infographic
- **Description**: Transform video transcripts into high-impact visual infographic summary cards with key statistics, notable quotes, and takeaways.

### YouTube AI Prompt Generator
- **URL**: https://www.mytranscript.pro/prompt
- **Description**: Generate visual image prompts and 4-panel comic strip scripts from video dialogue, engineered for Midjourney, FLUX, and DALL-E.

### YouTube Subtitle Downloader
- **URL**: https://www.mytranscript.pro/youtube-subtitle-downloader
- **Description**: Free online captions extractor to download subtitles in SRT, VTT, and plain text formats.

### YouTube Transcript Chatbot
- **URL**: https://www.mytranscript.pro/youtube-transcript-chatbot
- **Description**: Interactive Q&A chat assistant. Ask questions and chat directly with any YouTube video transcript using AI.

### YouTube Transcript Without Timestamps
- **URL**: https://www.mytranscript.pro/youtube-transcript-without-timestamps
- **Description**: Clean text extraction without timecodes for clean copying, reading, or pasting into AI models.

### YouTube Transcript Not Working Fix
- **URL**: https://www.mytranscript.pro/youtube-transcript-not-working
- **Description**: Troubleshooting guide and tool to extract captions even when YouTube player fails to show transcripts.

### YouTube to Infographic
- **URL**: https://www.mytranscript.pro/youtube-infographic
- **Description**: Transform video dialogue into visual stat cards, memorable quotes, and infographic summary points.

### Transcript AI Assistant
- **URL**: https://www.mytranscript.pro/transcript-ai
- **Description**: In-depth conversational AI assistant for questioning, clarifying, and analyzing video transcripts.

### Web App Interface
- **URL**: https://www.mytranscript.pro/app/
- **Description**: Full-screen distraction-free workspace for transcription processing and AI analysis.

## 2. Articles & Educational Guides

### How to Get a YouTube Transcript on Desktop and Mobile
- **URL**: https://www.mytranscript.pro/articles/how-to-get-youtube-transcript
- **Summary**: Comprehensive step-by-step guide for extracting YouTube video transcripts on desktop browsers, iPhone, and Android devices using native YouTube features and online tools.

### Why YouTube Transcript Is Not Showing and How to Fix It
- **URL**: https://www.mytranscript.pro/articles/why-youtube-transcript-not-showing-fix
- **Summary**: Diagnosing common caption issues including missing creator subtitles, unindexed auto-generated captions, browser extensions, and regional availability.

### How to Summarize Long YouTube Videos in Seconds Using AI
- **URL**: https://www.mytranscript.pro/articles/how-to-summarize-youtube-videos-ai
- **Summary**: Tutorial on using AI models to extract executive summaries, key takeaways, and chapter breakdowns from hour-long lectures and interviews.

### How to Download YouTube Subtitles as TXT or SRT Files
- **URL**: https://www.mytranscript.pro/articles/download-youtube-subtitles-srt-txt
- **Summary**: Exporting clean plain text transcripts and timecoded SRT subtitle files for video editors, students, and language learners.

### Extract Transcripts from Video Podcasts on YouTube
- **URL**: https://www.mytranscript.pro/articles/extract-podcast-transcript-youtube
- **Summary**: Turning long-form video podcasts into structured reading material, quote databases, and searchable study notes.

---

## 3. Technical Architecture & Privacy

- **Next.js App Router**: Built on modern Next.js 14 serverless architecture.
- **AI Processing Pipeline**: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash and OpenRouter LLM infrastructure for low-latency video comprehension.
- **Privacy-by-Default**: Zero user account requirements, zero permanent database storage of submitted URLs, and client-side storage for user preferences.
